title: UneceDocumentCharacteristic
description: A prominent attribute or aspect of a document.

description.description: A textual description of this document characteristic.

documentCharacteristicValueCode.description: A code specifying a value of this document characteristic.

identifier.description: An identifier for this document characteristic.

location.description: A location, expressed as text, for this document characteristic.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this document characteristic.

typeCode.description: A code specifying a type of document characteristic.

value.description: A value, expressed as text, for this document characteristic.

valueAdjustmentDirectionCode.description: The code specifying the adjustment direction for value of this document characteristic.

valueAmount.description: A value, expressed as a monetary value, for this document characteristic.

valueChangedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the value of this document characteristic is changed.

valueDateTime.description: A date, time, date time or other date time value for this document characteristic.

valueMeasure.description: A measure of a value for this document characteristic.

valueNumeric.description: A value, expressed as a number, for this document characteristic.

valuePercent.description: A value, expressed as a percentage, for this document characteristic.

valueQuantity.description: A value, expressed as a quantity, for this document characteristic.
